description:
Use this when you need an auditable federal-employee/office working-day count for a pinned year. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a state/local/private-employer/exchange or alternate work-schedule calendar.
What it computes: Counts US federal-baseline working and non-working dates using the OPM 2026-2027 schedule.
Example user requests: Count US federal working days from 2027-07-01 to 2027-07-10.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-07-01","end_date":"2027-07-10","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days, non_working_days, federal_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_observed, holiday_actual_dates, weekend_days, rest_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, source_quality, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += US federal status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/us-federal-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/us-federal-working-days-between.md
name: count_us_federal_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Federal employees and federal offices only.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or OPM federal holiday.

holiday_actual_dates.description: Underlying statutory holiday dates for observed events.

holiday_names.description: OPM federal holiday names applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when the date is the OPM in-lieu/observed date for a holiday whose actual date is a weekend.

rest_day_policy.description: OPM alternative work schedules need separate in-lieu resolution.

source_quality.description: Official OPM schedule and federal-law references.

sources.description: Official OPM, federal guidance and legislation sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count US Federal Working Days
